title: Localized cartesian base change for a relatively flat single sheaf
statement: Under the geometric hypotheses of lem-pc-cartesian-flat-single-termwise-comparison (quasi-compact quasi-separated f:X->S and p:Y->W, quasi-coherent M flat over p, nested opens U and V, a cartesian square q:X times_S V -> Y over g:V->W, and q^*M isomorphic to the restriction of F), the localized restriction over V of the restriction over U of Rf_*F[0] is isomorphic to localizedMixedDerivedPullback(U,V,W,g) applied to Rp_*M[0]. All source, target, auxiliary and localized-site derived-category universes are independently supplied as in the Lean signature. This has no complex P, representative isomorphism, or termwise functor L in its hypotheses or conclusion.

proof.text: Apply nestedOpen_single_directImage_comparison to identify the twice localized restriction with the transported direct image of the single sheaf tensorPullbackObj (pullback.fst f (V.ι ≫ U.ι)) F.
Apply localized_cartesian_flat_single_comparison to the square sq; this identifies the transported direct image of tensorPullbackObj q M with the requested localized mixed derived pullback.

Map the supplied eM through the single functor, derived direct image of pullback.snd, and the exact inverse overEquiv V. Its inverse connects the outputs of the two comparisons. Compose a, this inverse c, and b. This is the Lean term a ≪≫ c.symm ≪≫ b.

proof_origin.place: Tags 08FE and 0A1D; open and relatively flat comparisons split at the actual transported cartesian direct image, combined by functorial transport of eM
